scope: src/RackCad.Domain, all .cs files, in the extract of commit 3375aadbbf929427a6d106b2fff275d64863b89c (scratchpad/main2). Method: full Glob of src/RackCad.Domain/**/*.cs (61 files). Then an exhaustive Grep of the keyword "static" (every hit read), plus Greps for "readonly", "const", event, Lazy<, ThreadLocal, ThreadStatic, ModuleInitializer, AppDomain, Environment., File., Directory., Registry, Random, Interlocked, volatile, lock(, Guid.NewGuid, DateTime.Now/UtcNow and CurrentCulture. RESULT (FACT): the Domain assembly has no mutable static state at all. It has no non-readonly static fields, no static readonly fields of any type, no static settable properties, no static constructors, no module initializers, no [ThreadStatic]/ThreadLocal, no static events, no Lazy/Random/caches, and no file, registry, environment or AppDomain access. The only static member that holds an object is the get-only, immutable singleton SafetyFacePiece.None, reported below for completeness. Every other "static" hit is either a static class that holds only const members, or a pure static method that works on its arguments.

entries.declared_type: SafetyFacePiece (sealed class; get-only static auto-property, no setter)
entries.written_at: Only in the static auto-property initializer at src/RackCad.Domain/Systems/Selective/SafetyFacePiece.cs:35 (new SafetyFacePiece(isNone: true, elementId: null)). It has no setter, and nothing assigns it anywhere in src (Grep of SafetyFacePiece over src). The instance cannot change: the constructor is private (:28-32), and IsNone (:41) and ElementId (:44) are get-only auto-properties with no mutators.
entries.populated_when: At type initialization of SafetyFacePiece (implicit beforefieldinit field initializer, with no explicit static ctor), so no later than the first access to None. Readers of None are SafetyFacePiece.Of (SafetyFacePiece.cs:39) and src/RackCad.Application/Systems/PushBack/PushBackDefenseSides.cs:54. SafetyFacePiece.Resolve (SafetyFacePiece.cs:51-59) does not read None.
entries.reachability_chain: FACT: the only writers of the per-selection references that could hold None are PushBackDefenseSides.cs:65-66 (selection.NearFace/FarFace = FaceOf(...)), which is Push Back code. The only consumer of the faces is SelectivePalletDesign.cs:438-439 (ElementIdForFace -> SafetyFacePiece.Resolve), and its only caller is src/RackCad.Application/Systems/Dynamic/DynamicDefenseFaces.cs:31. The files that reference DynamicDefenseFaces or PushBackDefenseSides are all Dynamic, PushBack or PushBack-UI files (Application/Systems/Dynamic/*, Application/Systems/PushBack/*, UI/Systems/PushBack/*). None of them is Selective, Plugin, persistence or catalog code. A Grep of src/RackCad.Application/Systems/Selective for NearFace|FarFace|FaceOf|ElementIdForFace returns no hits. On the Selective path, SelectiveSafetySelection.DeepCopy only copies the reference (SelectivePalletDesign.cs:605-606), and that reference is null unless Push Back set it, so the copy never reads SafetyFacePiece.None. SelectivePalletDesignStore serializes a DTO document (src/RackCad.Application/Persistence/SelectivePalletDesignStore.cs:34,47), not the Domain SafetyFacePiece.
entries.warmup_risk: NONE. The value is immutable and built deterministically with no inputs: no path, no database, no catalog and no environment. It is identical whether or not a warm-up ran, so a scratch side-database warm-up cannot leave state here that changes a later governed run. The only effect of a warm-up is that type initialization has already happened, and that has no observable output.

Pure static methods that work on their arguments: SafetyFacePiece.Of/Resolve (SafetyFacePiece.cs:38-59), PushBackSideDesign.CopyFront (PushBackSideDesign.cs:95), CantileverStationDesign private Undefined(...) factory (CantileverStationDesign.cs:257).

readonly struct type declarations are types, not static fields: BootFaces (BootPlacement.cs:95), DynamicDepthSegment (DynamicRackFront.cs:15), DoubleDiagonalElevations (BracingDiagonalGeometry.cs:24).

Per-instance Guid.NewGuid() initializers are instance state, not static state: FrameHorizontal.cs:9, CantileverLineDesign.cs:333 and :408. Instance collection initializers such as SelectivePalletDesign.cs:411 (DerivedAisles = new List<...>) are also per-instance.
limitations: The census covers only src/RackCad.Domain. Static state in the other seam assemblies is out of scope and was not censused: Application (for example the SerializerOptions used by SelectivePalletDesignStore at SelectivePalletDesignStore.cs:34/47), Plugin (RackCatalogLoader, BlockLibraryDatabaseCache, RackLog, UserSettingsStore and others) and UI.

Reachability of SafetyFacePiece.None was established by symbol Grep over src (NearFace|FarFace|ElementIdForFace|FaceOf|SafetyFacePiece|DynamicDefenseFaces|PushBackDefenseSides), not by a full call-graph build. Reflection-based or serializer-driven access to the type cannot be excluded by Grep alone. UNCERTAIN only in that narrow sense; no such use was seen.

The extract contains no obj/ folder. RackCad.Domain.csproj:1-5 declares only TargetFramework net8.0, with no PackageReference or analyzer, so FACT: no source generator can add static state. Compiler-generated lambda caches (the <>c.<>9__ static fields behind a non-capturing lambda such as the one in SelectiveSafetyCells.Contains :159) are C# implementation artifacts. They hold stateless delegates and are not observable state.

Ambient BCL state (CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, StringComparer singletons) is outside Domain. The one culture-sensitive spot seen, CantileverArmTemplateComparer.Round at :98-99, explicitly uses InvariantCulture.
